summary: Planning template for 'improves' claims under a frozen charter rule. Two paths: (1) train/evaluate pipelines per seed (eidos.pytorch.*); (2) 'classification': from two training jobs' existing held-out predictions to an assessor verdict on ordinary (multiclass) accuracy. Request {claim, success_rule_id, assessor: {ref: 'eidos.assessors.paired-ci@1.2.0'}, required_isolation, classification: {labels: <artifact id>, predictions: {baseline: {<seed>: <artifact id>}, candidate: {<seed>: <artifact id>}}}} with a charter metric whose identity is classification-report/1:accuracy; it plans one eidos.task.paired-classification-report job per arm and seed. Never sets a success bar.
